Dashboard.title: Devices at a glance
Dashboard.subtitle: A device-accurate view of displays, alerts, and Home Assistant automation.
Dashboard.addDeviceDescription: Enter the one-time code shown on the device maintenance screen. The device must already be connected to Wi-Fi.
Dashboard.pairingCodeHelp: The code expires after 10 minutes and can only be used once.
Dashboard.pairing_code_invalid_or_expired: That pairing code is invalid or has expired.
Dashboard.pairing_code_in_use: That pairing code belongs to another device.
Dashboard.database_unavailable: The control plane database is unavailable.
Dashboard.devicesDescription: Select a device to inspect the display document it last confirmed.
Dashboard.noDevicesDescription: Put a device into enrollment mode, then add it here.
Dashboard.previewCurrent: Preview matches the current control-plane release.
Dashboard.previewRejected: The preview service did not accept this request.
Dashboard.previewSelected: {name} selected. Its confirmed display document is shown below.
Dashboard.publishFirstRelease: Pair a device, then publish its first display release.
Dashboard.pageControlDescription: Choose up to 10 pages and the next page to show. The confirmed page updates only after the device reports it.
Dashboard.pagesUnavailable: Publish a display release before configuring pages.
Dashboard.pagesSaved: Page configuration sent to the device.

Sources.title: Usage sources
Sources.subtitle: Collect subscription and status data on the control plane, then bind mapped values to display documents.
Sources.noSourcesDescription: Review a CC Switch export or create a source below.
Sources.testSucceeded: Request completed and mapped values were saved.
Sources.testFailed: Unable to complete the source request.
Sources.importDescription: The control plane only reviews request settings. It never executes extractor JavaScript or stores values from this preview.
Sources.importPlaceholder: Paste a CC Switch UsageScript JSON export
Sources.cc_switch_export_invalid: This export does not contain a usable request.
Sources.cc_switch_request_url_missing: The export has no request URL.
Sources.cc_switch_request_url_invalid: The request URL must use HTTP or HTTPS.
Sources.cc_switch_request_method_invalid: Only GET and POST requests can be imported.
Sources.cc_switch_export_too_large: The export is too large to review.
Sources.mappingRequired: JSONPath mappings are required before this source can be saved.
